# MeedyaDL 1.9.4

A focused fix for a stuck-download safety net that wasn't working as intended.

### What's fixed

- **Stuck downloads now actually get abandoned and released instead of warning forever.** The "no progress signal — will auto-fail after 20 min" safety check introduced in the previous release had a bug: its own warning message reset its own stall timer, so a genuinely stuck download (for example, one that hit a full disk) would keep warning every 10–11 minutes indefinitely instead of ever giving up and freeing the queue slot for the next item. One user saw this happen 38 times over 8 hours on a single stuck item. It now correctly gives up and moves on after 20 minutes as designed.
